title: Uncertainty Herding (UHerding)
text_0: **Idea:** UHerding greedily selects a batch by maximizing uncertainty-weighted coverage in feature space. It combines predictive uncertainty from a classifier with a kernel-based coverage objective and adapts the temperature scaling and kernel radius from the currently labeled data. Logits are preferred because they enable temperature scaling directly; if they are unavailable, UHerding falls back to the classifier's probability estimates.
